Phantom Ranch, Bright Angel Campground, the Canteen, and cabins remain fully closed, as do the Black Bridge and Silver Bridge river crossings and Boat Beach. A separate, previously announced Transcanyon Waterline construction closure between Redwall Bridge and the north end of Cottonwood Campground was planned to begin October 15, 2026 through approximately February 2027; since the trail is already fully closed from flood damage with no reopening estimate, this does not currently change anything but could extend closed status into 2027 even after flood repairs (Source: National Park Service).
